visual.title: The working set at the optimum
visual.caption: The working set is the list of constraints treated as equalities. Here both resource constraints are in it, and solving stationarity with those two normals gives positive multipliers.

predict.question: How many constraints are in the working set at (2, 1)?
predict.explain: Both resource constraints hold with equality at (2, 1), so the working set has two members. The two nonnegativity bounds hold strictly and stay out of the set.

label: Test optimality on a face
subgoals: use a negative multiplier to leave the face
